Only completed sets count toward sets and volume, including completed sets in active workouts. Workout count includes ended workouts with valid completed records. Training days are distinct completion dates.

Workout time excludes explicit pauses and includes normal rest between sets. External volume is weight × reps; dumbbells use weight per dumbbell × total reps from both sides. Assistance and cardio are excluded from external volume.

Exercise trends show one point per valid completed set, in completion order, keeping all sets from the same day. The horizontal axis is not a proportional timeline. Total external weight and weight per dumbbell are shown separately.
